f3_program: collection("children.ant_counts", "ant_count", "children", source("the four children"))
observe(at("children.count", "current"), 4, "count", source("four children"))
member("children.ant_counts", "abe.ants.count", source("Abe finds 4 ants"))
member("children.ant_counts", "beth.ants.count", source("Beth sees 50% more ants than Abe"))
member("children.ant_counts", "cece.ants.count", source("CeCe watches twice as many ants as Abe"))
member("children.ant_counts", "duke.ants.count", source("Duke discovers half as many ants as Abe"))
observe(at("abe.ants.count", "current"), 4, "count", source("Abe finds 4 ants on the sidewalk"))
percent_more(at("beth.ants.count", "current"), at("abe.ants.count", "current"), 50, source("Beth sees 50% more ants than Abe"))
multiple(at("cece.ants.count", "current"), at("abe.ants.count", "current"), 2, source("CeCe watches twice as many ants as Abe"))
fraction_of(at("duke.ants.count", "current"), at("abe.ants.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("Duke discovers half as many ants as Abe"))
query("sum", "children.ant_counts", "current")
collection("nicole.pokemon_cards", "pokemon_card", "nicole", source("Nicole collected 400 Pokemon cards"))
observe(at("nicole.pokemon_cards.count", "current"), 400, "count", source("Nicole collected 400 Pokemon cards"))
collection("cindy.pokemon_cards", "pokemon_card", "cindy", source("Cindy collected twice as many"))
multiple(at("cindy.pokemon_cards.count", "current"), at("nicole.pokemon_cards.count", "current"), 2, source("Cindy collected twice as many"))

sum_relation(at("nicole_and_cindy.combined_pokemon_cards.count", "current"), at("nicole.pokemon_cards.count", "current"), at("cindy.pokemon_cards.count", "current"), source("Nicole and Cindy's combined total"))
collection("rex.pokemon_cards", "pokemon_card", "rex", source("Rex collected half of Nicole and Cindy's combined total"))
fraction_of(at("rex.pokemon_cards.count", "before_division"), at("nicole_and_cindy.combined_pokemon_cards.count", "current"), 1, 2, source("Rex collected half of Nicole and Cindy's combined total"))
collection("rex.card_recipients", "person", "rex.family", source("himself and his three younger siblings"))
member("rex.card_recipients", "rex", source("himself"))
collection("rex.card_recipients.younger_siblings", "person", "rex.family", source("his three younger siblings"))
observe(at("rex.card_recipients.younger_siblings.count", "current"), 3, "count", source("three younger siblings"))
partition("rex.card_recipients", at("rex.pokemon_cards.count", "before_division"), source("Rex divided his card equally among himself and his three younger siblings"))

transfer("rex_card_division", "rex", at("rex.pokemon_cards.count", "current"), at("rex.card_recipients.younger_siblings.pokemon_cards.count", "current"), "rex.card_recipients.younger_siblings.received_pokemon_cards.count", source("Rex divided his card equally among himself and his three younger siblings"))
query("remaining_count", "rex.pokemon_cards", "current")
assumptions: The singular phrase "his card" refers to Rex's collected Pokémon-card collection.

f3_program: collection("gathering.participants", "person", "gathering", source("Josh gets together with 7 friends"))
member("gathering.participants", "josh", source("including him"))
collection("gathering.participants.friends", "friend", "gathering", source("7 friends"))
observe(at("gathering.participants.friends.count", "current"), 7, "count", source("7 friends"))
observe(at("gathering.contribution_per_participant.amount", "current"), 5, "dollar", source("Everyone including him puts 5 dollars into a pot"))

product_relation(at("gathering.total_contributions.amount", "current"), at("gathering.participants.count", "current"), at("gathering.contribution_per_participant.amount", "current"), source("Everyone including him puts 5 dollars into a pot"))

add("pot_contributions", "gathering.participants", at("gathering.pot.money", "current"), at("gathering.total_contributions.amount", "current"), source("Everyone including him puts 5 dollars into a pot"))
percent_of(at("gathering.first_place.prize.amount", "current"), event_field("pot_contributions", "quantity"), 80, source("First place gets 80% of the money"))

difference_relation(at("gathering.remaining_prize_pool.amount", "current"), event_field("pot_contributions", "quantity"), at("gathering.first_place.prize.amount", "current"), source("Second and third place split the rest"))
collection("gathering.remaining_prize_shares", "money_share", "gathering", source("Second and third place split the rest"))
member("gathering.remaining_prize_shares", "gathering.second_place.prize.amount", source("Second and third place"))
member("gathering.remaining_prize_shares", "gathering.third_place.prize.amount", source("Second and third place"))
partition("gathering.remaining_prize_shares", at("gathering.remaining_prize_pool.amount", "current"), source("Second and third place split the rest"))
query("value", at("gathering.third_place.prize.amount", "current"))
assumptions: The phrase "split the rest" denotes an equal partition between second and third place.

f3_program: observe(at("company.contractual_obligations.finjan_mobile_future_commitment.amount", "less_than_1_year"), 650, "thousand_currency", cell("Finjan Mobile future commitment", "Less Than 1 Year"))
observe(at("company.contractual_obligations.total.amount", "total"), 7478, "thousand_currency", cell("Total", "Total"))
query("percentage_ratio", at("company.contractual_obligations.finjan_mobile_future_commitment.amount", "less_than_1_year"), at("company.contractual_obligations.total.amount", "total"))

assumptions: The requested yearly savings requires a month-to-year conversion factor that the source does not assert and F3-v1 does not allow annotators to invent.
